question:
Select the appropriate synonym of the given word.

Elusive
solution:
The correct answer is: **Evasive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Elusive"** means something that is difficult to find, catch, or achieve. (मायावी / कठिन पकड़ने योग्य)

 
 
• **Example: **The criminal has been elusive, avoiding capture for years despite numerous police efforts.
 
 
 
• **"Evasive"** refers to someone or something that avoids or escapes from a situation, often by being clever or indirect. (टालने वाला)
 
 
• **Example: **The politician gave an evasive answer to avoid controversy.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Elusive'** is **'Evasive'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Evasive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Clear** (स्पष्ट): Easily understood, obvious, or transparent.

 
 
• **Example:** The instructions were clear, so there was no confusion.
 
 
 
• **Obvious** (स्पष्ट): Easily perceived or understood; evident.
 
 
• **Example: **It was obvious that she was upset by her facial expression.
 
 
 
• **Definite** (निश्चित): Clearly stated or decided; not vague or doubtful.
 
 
• **Example:** The manager gave us a definite deadline for completing the project.
